Rich disables progress animations when it detects that output is not a terminal. The `force_interactive` Console option can override this; see [terminal detection and interactive mode](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/docs/source/console.rst). For other usage questions, please use [Discussions](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/discussions).
